en.join.meta.title: Join Us | Wu Lab
en.join.meta.description: Open positions and collaboration opportunities in the Wu Lab.
en.join.head.title: Join Us
en.join.head.lead: Admission and recruitment information for the Wu Lab at the Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences.
en.join.students.title: Master & PhD Students
en.join.students.lead: The lab currently has openings for Master’s and PhD students in 2025. Please email Prof. Qin Wu at wuqin@ibmc.ac.cn for inquiries.
en.join.paths.title: Graduate Admissions Pathways
en.join.path1.title: Summer Camp
en.join.path1.body: Please refer to the “Find Molecular & Medicine” Summer Camp notice of the Hangzhou Institute of Medicine (2024) and the 2024 Summer Camp notice of the UCAS Hangzhou Advanced Research Institute.
en.join.path2.title: Recommended Admission Interview
en.join.path2.body: After the summer camp, recommended graduate admission interviews are available. Please follow the “2025 Recommended Admission (including direct PhD) Notice” of the Hangzhou Institute of Medicine.
en.join.path3.title: National Graduate Entrance Exam
en.join.path3.body: Please refer to the 2025 National Graduate Entrance Exam and the 2025 Master’s Admissions Brochure and Major Catalog of the Hangzhou Institute of Medicine.
en.join.joint.title: Joint Training Programs
en.join.joint.body: We jointly train graduate students with the University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Chemistry (CAS), Tianjin University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, University of Macau, Hunan University, Institute of Modern Physics (CAS), Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University of Technology, Wenzhou Medical University, and others. Please follow each university’s admissions policies.
en.join.postdoc.title: Postdoctoral Researchers
en.join.postdoc.lead: The lab is recruiting postdoctoral researchers. Please email Prof. Qin Wu at wuqin@him.cas.cn for inquiries.
en.join.directions.title: Research Directions
en.join.dir1.title: Functional Nucleic Acid Tools
en.join.dir1.body: Develop aptamer screening methods for undruggable proteins and protein interactions; build cell-based selection and target identification for membrane proteins; generate high-throughput aptamer libraries for cell atlas construction.
en.join.dir2.title: Single-Cell Omics & Multi-omics Analysis
en.join.dir2.body: Develop aptamer-based tools for single-cell surface proteomics, interactomics, and spatial multi-omics to systematically decode tumor evolution.
en.join.dir3.title: New Targets & Cell Therapy
en.join.dir3.body: Use single-cell and spatial multi-omics on clinical samples to identify therapeutic targets and develop CAR-T and other cell therapies.
en.join.background.title: Desired Background
en.join.background.body: Bioinformatics, immunology, structural biology, cell biology, molecular biology, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, or related fields. Experience in omics data analysis is preferred.
en.join.requirements.title: Postdoctoral Recruitment Requirements
en.join.req1: Abide by laws and regulations, strong academic record, and good physical and mental health.
en.join.req2: Typically under 35 years old; PhD graduates or within 3 years of PhD completion.
en.join.req3: Strong academic background, research potential, and team spirit; major aligns with lab needs; able to work full-time on postdoctoral research.
en.join.benefits.title: Postdoctoral Compensation & Benefits
en.join.benefit1: Annual salary RMB 300,000 (pre-tax) plus performance incentives; RMB 400,000 (pre-tax) during national fellowship funding for selected programs.
en.join.benefit2: Same benefits as institute staff, including cafeteria allowance (RMB 6,600/year), union benefits, and VIP physical exams at top-tier hospitals.
en.join.benefit3: Five social insurances and one housing fund as required by national policy.
en.join.benefits.note: Outstanding postdocs will be prioritized for long-term positions, with talent recruitment benefits. The institute has a strategic partnership with Hangzhou Medical College, offering priority access to institutional teaching positions after postdoc completion.
en.join.apply.title: How to Apply
en.join.apply.body: Please send your CV to wuqin@him.cas.cn with the subject line “Postdoc + Name + Research Direction”.

zh.join.meta.title: 加入我们 | 吴芩课题组
zh.join.meta.description: 吴芩课题组招生与招聘信息。
zh.join.head.title: 加入我们
zh.join.head.lead: 中国科学院杭州医学研究所吴芩课题组招生与招聘信息。
zh.join.students.title: 硕士与博士研究生
zh.join.students.lead: 课题组目前仍有 2025 年硕士和博士研究生招生名额，欢迎邮件咨询吴芩老师：wuqin@ibmc.ac.cn。
zh.join.paths.title: 研究生招生途径
zh.join.path1.title: 夏令营
zh.join.path1.body: 具体要求和细节可参考中国科学院杭州医学研究所 2024 年“Find 分子与医学”优秀大学生夏令营报名通知，以及国科大杭州高等研究院关于 2024 年优秀大学生夏令营报名的通知。
zh.join.path2.title: 推免面试
zh.join.path2.body: 夏令营活动结束后可进行推免研究生面试，具体时间和要求请密切关注中国科学院杭州医学研究所 2025 年接收推荐免试研究生（含直博生）的通知。
zh.join.path3.title: 研究生招生考试
zh.join.path3.body: 具体要求和细节可参考 2025 年全国硕士研究生招生考试、中国科学院杭州医学研究所 2025 年招收攻读硕士学位研究生简章及专业目录。
zh.join.joint.title: 联合培养途径
zh.join.joint.body: 本所与中国科学技术大学、中国科学院化学研究所、天津大学、上海交通大学、澳门大学、湖南大学、中国科学院兰州近代物理研究所、浙江大学、浙江工业大学、温州医科大学等高校和研究机构联合培养研究生，详情请参考各高校招生政策。
zh.join.postdoc.title: 博士后招聘
zh.join.postdoc.lead: 课题组欢迎博士后申请，欢迎邮件咨询吴芩老师：wuqin@him.cas.cn。
zh.join.directions.title: 研究方向
zh.join.dir1.title: 功能核酸工具开发
zh.join.dir1.body: 针对难成药蛋白及其相互作用发展适配体筛选新方法，针对膜蛋白建立细胞筛选和靶标鉴定技术，高通量获得适配体分子工具并用于细胞图谱构建。
zh.join.dir2.title: 单细胞组学与多组学分析
zh.join.dir2.body: 发展基于适配体的单细胞表面蛋白组学、互作组学和空间多组学技术，系统解析肿瘤发生发展过程。
zh.join.dir3.title: 新靶点发现与细胞治疗
zh.join.dir3.body: 利用单细胞与空间多组学技术表征临床样本，发现治疗靶点并发展 CAR-T 等新型细胞治疗策略。
zh.join.background.title: 专业背景
zh.join.background.body: 欢迎生物信息学、免疫学、结构生物学、细胞生物学、分子生物学、药学、生物医学等相关专业申请；具有组学数据分析经验者优先。
zh.join.requirements.title: 博士后招聘要求
zh.join.req1: 遵纪守法，品学兼优，身心健康。
zh.join.req2: 年龄一般不超过 35 岁，应届博士毕业生或获博士学位不超过 3 年。
zh.join.req3: 具有良好的学术背景和研究基础，富有发展潜力及团队合作精神；专业符合课题组需求，并能全职从事博士后研究。
zh.join.benefits.title: 博士后薪酬待遇
zh.join.benefit1: 年薪 30 万元（税前），享受科研奖励；入选国家博士后相关人才计划者，在国家资助期内年薪提高至 40 万元（税前）。
zh.join.benefit2: 享受所内正式员工同等福利，包括食堂餐补、工会福利及三甲医院 VIP 体检套餐。
zh.join.benefit3: 按国家规定缴纳五险一金。
zh.join.benefits.note: 博士后期间成果突出者，同等条件下优先留所发展，并按人才引进政策待遇执行；另医学所与杭州医学院建立人才战略合作关系，博士后出站后可优先安排事业编制教师岗位。
zh.join.apply.title: 申请方式
zh.join.apply.body: 请将简历发送至 wuqin@him.cas.cn，邮件主题请注明“博士后+姓名+研究方向”。
